_comment: The sourcing bot's memory. Every role it shortlists is appended here (status 'shortlisted'); roles Shankar reports applying to get status 'applied'. The bot MUST read this before finalizing a day's five and never re-list a url (or company+role pair) that appears here. Bot-owned like shortlist.config.ts, but append-only: entries are never removed or rewritten. Not imported by the build — pure ledger.
